children: Palm oil (FCPOc3) may retest support at 4,732 ringgit per metric ton, a break below which may trigger a fall into the 4,677-4,711 ringgit range.
A pullback toward a triple-top has completed. The pattern suggests a target of 4,622 ringgit, which a falling trendline also points to.
Immediate resistance is at 4,766 ringgit, a break above which may trigger a gain into the 4,799-4,820 ringgit range.
